page.layout: One column of dictionary entries (Hebrew lexicon, Latin glosses), with Hebrew headwords and citations. No marginal notes. Signature mark at the lower left.

main_text.p: v.14. Hiph. Particip. מחכימת פתי Sapientiam afferentes simplici, Psalm.19.8. Hitbp. Futurum, ואל־תתחכם יותר Ne sapiens sis vel sapere tibi videtor nimiùm, Eccles.7.17. ונתחכמה לו [?] Sapienter geramus nos ipsi, id est, adversus ipsum, Exod.1.10. Affute illum opprimamus.

חָכָם־לֵב m. Sapiens, Peritus; Prov.3.7. Constr. חכם־לב Sapiens animo, Prov.10.8. Plural. הוי חכמים Vt sapientibus, Jes.5.21. Constr. חכמי־לב Sapientes animo, Exod.28. v.3. Aff. חכמיו Sapientes ejus, Esther 6.13. Chald. חכימין Sapientes, Dan.2.21. Emph. חכימיא v.13. Construct. חכימי בבל Sapientes Babyloniae, vers.12. Foem. אשה חכמה Mulier sapiens, 2.Sam.20.16. Plural. אל־החכמות Ad sapientes, Jer.9.17. Constr. חכמות נשים Sapiens quaelibet mulierum, Prov.14.1.

חָכְמָה f. Sapientia, Prov.3.13. Constr. את־חכמת שלמה Sapientiam Salomonis, 1.Reg.4.34. Aff. את חכמתו Sapientiam ejus, Ibid. Plur. ידבר חכמות Eloquetur sapientias, Psal.49.4. Chald. שכלתנו וחכמה Intelligentia ac sapientia, Dan.5.11. Emph. חכמתא וגבורתא Sapientiam & potentiam, Dan.2.23. Constr. כחכמת אלהיך Pro sapientia Dei tui, Esr.7.25.

חַכְמוֹנִי m. Chachmonaeus, Nomen gentile, 1.Paralip.11. v.11. Idem etiam appellatus fuit תחכמוני Tachkemonita, 2.Sam.23. v.8. Quidam, Sapiens, Sapientiae doctor, quasi sit Nomen, supremum quendam sapientiae gradum designans.

חלא חלאה Spuma: Aff. אשר חלאתה בה Cujus spuma est in ea, Ezech.24.v.6. ubi deficit Mapik: וחלאתה Et spuma ejus, Ibid. v.11. R.Sal. scribit: Est excrementum, quod educitur ex ore ollae per ebullitionem, quod vocant אשקמא Efcume, id est, Spuma; Quidam Æruginem reddunt. Sic quoque Kimchi explicat.

page.notes: Vowel points and several Hebrew words in the upper entries are faint or doubtful; Hebrew is copied in consonantal form where the points are not clear. Marked [?] where uncertain: ונתחכמה לו (Exod.1.10 line) and "Afflute" in the Latin gloss. Long s has been normalised to s (Psalm, Eccles, Efther, Jef, Efr), as the rules require. The large headword letters in the last entry are read as one headword. Faint marks at the bottom centre are not transcribed.
